ambition: 30–40%better than the fixed baseline is an informal aspiration; it is neither a required threshold nor a stopping condition.
breadth: Broader representative checks at meaningful milestones or to investigate inconsistent/uncertain gains, rather than automatic full-panel evaluation after every improvement.
existing_full_checkpoints: Preserve all completed native checkpoints for potential final resume after the stopping review; do not classify partial evaluation as a full-panel completed model.
final_full_regressions: If the final full check contradicts the stopping judgment or reveals an unresolved credible improvement, reopen development rather than declare success.
full_panel_gate: A documented evidence-based stopping review is satisfied before final retained suite launch. Reaching a small win, losing a few variants, or an aspiration percentage does not satisfy the gate.
iterations: Explore concurrent mechanism contrasts and small variants around the working incumbent using shared fits and cheap matched samples; promote sample-validated improvements as working incumbents and continue iterating.
methodology_scope: Any credible methodology is allowed, including structural changes and other model families. Prefer simple improvements but do not restrict the search to a family or neighbourhood.
model_parameters: Prefer training-derived parameters; avoid arbitrary fixed component percentages. Frozen panel and score remain unchanged.
screen_simulations: Lower counts allowed for exploratory credibility screens;1000for declared validated scores.
selection: Single fixed canonical overall distributional score, identical coverage and simulation counts; no diagnostic/horizon routing or extra weights.
